title: Sharma (1996) slope with a reinforced zone (φ = 54.93°)

meta.title: Sharma (1996) slope with a reinforced zone (φ = 54.93°)
meta.notes: The V081a sand slope (φ′ = 36°, 40 kPa surcharge) with a 7.6 m reinforced zone of φ = 54.93° (tan φ = 1.96 tan 36°) behind the face, on the reference critical toe circle (8.707, 18.307, R = 13.813).

source.reference: Sharma (1996). Verification manual of a commercial slope stability program.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V081b (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: φ = 36° and γ = 20 kN/m³ of the slope are not printed in the manual (tan 54.93° = 1.96 tan 36°; γ as V081a). Zone base (5, 5)–(12.6, 5), back face parallel to the slope face; 40 kPa from x = 17 to 30.
commercial program A's required force 351 kN and zone length 7.6 m (program F 345 kN, 7.5 m) give FOS 1.504 against the target 1.5.
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
